maxAttempts.why: A count is what stops a retry loop becoming a denial of service against a dependency that is already failing.

baseDelayMs.why: The first wait is what separates a retry from a second copy of the same request.

multiplier.why: Backoff is what lets a dependency recover instead of meeting the same load on every attempt.

maxDelayMs.why: A cap on the wait is what bounds the total duration together with the attempt count, so a caller knows when it will hear an answer.

jitter.why: Without jitter every client that failed at the same moment retries at the same moment, and the recovery is the next outage.

maxRetryAfterMs.why: A provider can ask for an arbitrarily long wait; the cap is what keeps one header from parking a request for an hour.

userVisibleRetry.why: A turn that failed after the user sent it is the one case where trying again is the reader's call, so the surface has to know which message to resend.
